# Parma

Parma CRM is a relationship management app designed to help you accelerate growth by deepening and nurturing your business relationships.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/parma/.

## Actions

- **Get User Profile** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user's profile.
- **Get data.json metadata** (read-only): Retrieve dcat-us 1.1 compliant metadata of all datasets.
- **List Parma CKAN datasets** (read-only): Retrieve all dataset identifiers from the parma ckan instance.
